name: Sports Hub
description: Live game scoreboard tracker, Kalshi win probabilities, and sports alerts across major leagues.
author: Luma

items.name: Live Scoreboard
items.description: Track an ongoing game with live score, clock, and Kalshi win probability.

settings.label: Tracked league
settings.description: League to follow in the Live Scoreboard widget, or Auto to pick the closest live game across major leagues.

settings.label: Pin team (optional)
settings.description: Team name or abbreviation to follow (e.g. Lakers, BOS). Leave blank to auto-pick the closest live game.

settings.label: Spoiler-free mode
settings.description: Hide live scores on the widget while still showing the game clock and status.

settings.label: Show win probability on widget
settings.description: Include live Kalshi win-probability bar inside the Live Scoreboard widget.

settings.label: Show odds on Sports cards
settings.description: Display Kalshi win probabilities next to matchups on the Sports page.

settings.label: Show odds widget while watching
settings.description: Show a compact live Kalshi win-probability widget in the Sports player.

settings.label: Refresh interval
settings.description: How often to pull the latest live scores and market odds.
